data.text: Playwright is a cross-browser testing framework developed by Microsoft that enables reliable end-to-end testing for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It supports multiple languages and has built-in auto-waiting and tracing.

data.title: Playwright Test
data.content: Run a test across multiple browsers with Playwright.

terms.definition: Playwright tests run on Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with the same API.
Playwright automatically waits for elements to be actionable before interacting.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Playwright supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Built-in code generation and trace viewer
data.takeaway: Playwright is the most comprehensive cross-browser E2E testing tool.
